UKHC010174492025
BCA/22/2025
Sheetal Chamoli
--Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Ms. Medha Gaur, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned A.G.A. with Mrs. 
Shweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for the 
State.
3. Mr. Siddharth Bankoti, learned counsel for the 
respondent.
4. The accused Basant Kumar Chamoli- the 
respondent no. 2 granted bail by this court on 14.08.2025 
against whom there is a charge of sexual assault with her 
own minor daughter and now facing trial for the offences 
punishable under sections 323, 376, 504, 506 of IPC r/w 
section 5(l)(n)/6 of POCSO Act.
5. The present applicant is the sister of victim raising 
serious allegation that after being released on bail the 
accused, who is her father is giving regular threat, 
regarding which the present applicant also lodged the 
FIR on 13.10.2025 bearing FIR No. 0630 of 2025 at P.S. 
Nehru Colony.
6. List this matter on 16.09.2026.
7. By that time the State as well as respondent no. 2 
may file their response.
8. In the meantime, Mr. Tumul Nainwal may instruct 
to the authority concerned to enquire about the written 
complaint of the present applicant and he may also get 
the instructions about the status of the investigation of 
Case Crime No. 0630 of 2025.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 21.08.2026
PR
